basic_details.short_information: Students with a B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MBA or similar degree and a minimum of 60 per cent marks in the degree programme can apply for the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) Internship Programme. Interns receive a stipend of Rs. 20,000 every month and an official NHAI experience certificate. Applications are made online on NHAI's official internship website. The last date is 10 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates apply online on NHAI's official internship website by 10 November 2026. The notice does not describe the steps of the online form, the documents to upload or how candidates are selected.

rows.details: National highway infrastructure projects across India

content_sections.heading: About NHAI Intern
content_sections.text: The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) is running an Internship Programme for students. The notice describes the internship as work on projects related to national highway infrastructure across India, with guidance from NHAI's experienced engineers and project managers. The announcement appeared in Amar Ujala, Delhi, on 7 November 2026 (page 10).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The NHAI Internship Programme is open to students. The notice sets two conditions: Degree: a B.Tech/B.E., M.Tech, MBA or similar degree. The notice says "etc." after these degrees, so this list is not complete. Marks: a minimum of 60 per cent marks in the degree programme. The notice does not mention an age limit. For the full list of accepted degrees, check the official notification on the NHAI internship website.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Each NHAI intern receives a stipend of Rs. 20,000 every month. At the end of the internship, NHAI gives interns an official experience certificate. The notice does not specify how long the internship lasts.

content_sections.heading: NHAI Intern Job Description
content_sections.text: Get guidance from NHAI's experienced engineers and project managers. Work on projects related to national highway infrastructure across India.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHAI Intern
content_sections.text: Candidates apply online on NHAI's official internship website by 10 November 2026. The notice does not describe the steps of the online form, the documents to upload or how candidates are selected.
